Hello.

It feels very refreshing to have a new identity here. I had been a redditor for about three and a half years before leaving, so not as long as many of you, but I still feel like I was there long enough to witness a shift towards what seemed like product placement. Reddit seemed to like certain products, people, or ideas in phases. For a couple weeks, I'd see certain marketing things absolutely flood my front page (and /r/all). I'm sure that you all know what I'm talking about.

Some of the major ones were Conan in /r/videos and /r/funny (powered by Team Coco, of course), Neil DeGrasse Tyson, Elon Musk, Chris Pratt (there are currently 3 Jurassic World videos on the first page of /r/videos), John Oliver, and Louis CK just to name a few. I have nothing against these people, and in fact, I support what they do, but it has gotten to the point where I feel like the ads are the content.

Of course, I could've just unsubscribed from those subs, but there was other original and good content being generated there too. So now here I am, in search of a genuine community.

I really hope that voat takes off. Reddit is too big and too influential for its own good. There are still subreddits that I'll go to for now, just because their voat counterparts are way too tiny for the time being, but I hope that this is the beginning of something good.

Anyway, I guess that's my intro. I'd love to hear other opinions about the product placement on reddit.
